CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to the same referent/time with literal evidence.

COD.rationale: Content (red at coordinate) is identified and shown as currently presented with a separate origin/status field in the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Report uses processing-state labels (current/candidate) but provides no explicit attention/allocation statement bound to the same content with literal linking evidence.

C.rationale: The text names represented contents with attributes and coordinates (e.g. red at (0,3)) attached to model-state referents.

D.rationale: An origin/status field is provided separately from the content coordinates, distinguishing identification from provenance/status.

O.rationale: Contents are presented with a 'current' state label indicating their present access/presentation in the model-state referent.
